profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Senior software engineer and technology team leader with over 20 years’ experience gained in software development and process improvement.  Proven success in development of innovative solutions, implementing applications, and leading teams of technology professionals.  Able to leverage superior problem solving, facilitation, and consensus building skills to drive strategic and tactical goals.  Lead with a focus on customer service and technical transparency. Skilled in employing Agile and Scrum processes to guide development and improvement of technology initiatives.  Full native verbal and written fluency in Spanish.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead architecture and delivery of complex software initiatives, translating business requirements into scalable solutions and mentoring engineers on design and implementation.
• Design and build cloud-native services on AWS using Node.js and TypeScript, with microservices and REST APIs that support integrations across business systems.
• Guide technical decisions across service architecture, API design, and cloud infrastructure, balancing maintainability, performance, and reliability.
• Build and improve high-scale systems, addressing performance bottlenecks and strengthening resilience as demand grows.
• Improve production reliability through monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting, helping teams identify issues and restore service efficiently.
• Use AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot to support implementation, refactoring, and test development, reviewing generated code for quality and correctness.
• Apply AWS expertise and knowledge gained through AWS Certified Solutions Architect to guide cloud architecture and engineering practices.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Reactjs · Gitlab · AWS · TypeScript · Node.js · Git · Python (Programming Language) · Next.js · Java

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developing scalable solutions using PHP, Laravel, React, Node & Clojure
• Building cloud solutions with AWS Cognito, Lambdas, S3, and more
positions.insights: Skills: Laravel · JavaScript · Reactjs · PHP · AWS · GitHub · Clojure · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Cloud Computing · Node.js · Git

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Led effort to build new Restful API
• Led effort to migrate main client application from CodeIgniter to React & Laravel
• Helped set up PHPUnit and React Testing Library for API and client testing suites
• Helped implement a continuous integration and deployment process
• Building application integrations using Domain Driven Design and Microservices
• Developing scalable solutions using PHP, Laravel & React
• Supporting BreezeChms development and maintenance
• Served on the company’s Tech Council to promote engineering best practices
positions.insights: Skills: Laravel · Reactjs · PHP · GitHub · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · jQuery · Git

positions.title: Director of Application Development
positions.description:
• Steering the technical work of developers and engineers
• Develop and enhance technical development processes, standard and software engineering best practices (capacity planning, monitoring, configuration, security, historical metrics, recovery strategies and migration strategies)
• Advise senior leaders and stakeholders
• Estimate, plan and oversee development activities
• Document and diagram complex technical processes
• Assess delivery impediments, risks, issues, and changes to development projects
• Provide technical evaluation of prospective vendors and partners
• Partner with product managers to design features and prioritize work

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Maintained company’s legacy extranet, a ASP.Net Master Page web application
• Successfully planned and operationalized a 2-year project to port a legacy extranet from ASP.Net Webforms Application to PHP Laravel Framework
• Maintain company’s MS SQL and MySQL databases 
• Integrated Auth0 Identity as a service
• Integrated Algolia search as a service
• Synchronized data between company’s member portal and SalesForce CRM
• Manage complex ETL process for importing vendor content

positions.title: Team Lead, IT Application Development
positions.description:
Team Lead – Application Development (ASP.Net using C#, JavaScript, JSON and T-SQL)

• Develop Microsoft CRM Customizations using .Net in support of the company’s operations
• Develop ASP.Net back-office applications
• Develop Web Services to support external applications
• Create infrastructure mechanisms for future application development
• Design & maintain MS SQL table schemas and stored procedures.
• Create & maintain user documentation
• Mentor and lead agile teams
• Scrum Master

positions.title: CRM Developer
positions.description:
CRM Developer (ASP.Net using C#, JavaScript, JSON and T-SQL)

• Develop Microsoft CRM Customizations using .Net in support of the company’s operations
• Develop ASP.Net back-office applications
• Develop Web Services to support external applications
• Create infrastructure mechanisms for future application development
• Design & maintain MS SQL table schemas and stored procedures.
• Create & maintain user documentation

positions.title: Application Systems Analyst II
positions.description:
Application Systems Analyst II (ASP.Net using VB.Net, C#, AJAX, XML and T-SQL)

• Develop Microsoft CRM Customizations using .Net in support of the company’s operations
• Develop ASP.Net back-office applications
• Develop Web Services to support external applications
• Create infrastructure mechanisms for future application development
• Design & maintain MS SQL table schemas.
• Create, maintain & tune MS SQL stored procedures
• Create & maintain user documentation
• Instrumental in designing frame work for supporting company’s highly customized business requirements

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer (C#, VB.Net, VB, T-SQL, Flex 2)

• Enhanced & Maintained back office software in support of the company’s currency exchange platform.
• Developed dynamic reports 
• Supported porting legacy systems from VB6 to .Net
• Designed & Maintained MS SQL table schemas.
• Created, Maintained and tuned MS SQL stored procedures
• Maintained MS SQL replication
• Managed monthly back office software release
• Developed API Guide for Company’s proprietary messaging protocol
• Developed Flex 2 Web Based Version of Company’s Windows Based Trading Application

positions.title: Programmer Analyst II
positions.description:
Programmer Analyst II (March 2003 – July 2006)

• Designed and Developed new software in support of the company’s suite of software applications.
• Reviewed function specifications and created technical specifications based on functional requirements using UML process modeling.
• Provided support to corporate intranet site. 
• Became proficient in the following programming languages: Progress, VB.Net, VB, ASP (VBScript / JavaScript).
• Became proficient in working with the following databases: Progress, Oracle & Access. Conduct testing as directed to ensure proper operation and defect free software.

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
Business Analyst / Quality Assurance Analyst 
(October 2001 – March 2003)

• Prepared business specifications from which technical specifications were formulated.
• Conducted research on business industry practices and compliance issues.
• Analyzed product requirements, translated them into defined business specifications.
• Developed test plans, conducted testing and disseminated information effectively.

positions.title: Corporal, Squad Leader, Anti-Tank Assaultman
positions.description:
Served as a Squad Leader of an Anti-Tank assault team in peacetime and during the Persian Gulf War. 

Decorated with the following awards for distinctive service in combat:

• Navy Commendation Medal with a Combat V
• Combat Action Ribbon
• Selected Marine Corps Reserve Medal
• USMC Expeditionary Ribbon
• National Defense Medal
• Southwest Asia Service Medal
• Sea Service Deployment Ribbon
• Kuwait Liberation Medal (Awarded by the nation of Kuwait)
• Kuwait Liberation Medal (Awarded by the nation of Saudi Arabia)
